# The Mystery at the Hotel: Maia and Alex, Detectives of Success Book

Tired of predictable crime stories? Dive into a captivating whodunit with *The Mystery at the Hotel: Maia and Alex, Detectives of Success*. Written by Litera, this thrilling novel plunges readers into the heart of luxury suspense, following two brilliant amateur sleuths as they solve a baffling case within the walls of an extravagant city hotel.

The story begins when the Renet family checks into their luxurious apartment at a grand downtown hotel. Amidst the glamour and privilege comes a seemingly perfect life, centering around their precious puppy, Jonathan. Though the hotel director assures them of utmost care, disaster strikes quickly: Jonathan vanishes!

Alex and Maia are called upon to investigate. Using their keen detective skills and sharp wits, they begin tracking down clues that point fingers among the very staff who work inside the grand establishment. As suspicion mounts, the question becomes: Who among the hotel employees is responsible for this mystery?

This fast-paced **mystery novel** combines elements of classic detective fiction with a modern setting, keeping readers guessing until the final page. If you love complex puzzles and brilliant amateur sleuths, your next read has arrived.
